description: This is the implementation of a CyclicBuffer class used for managing a ring buffer with concurrent access, including mechanisms for locking, reading, writing, reservation, and notifications. The file manages low-level buffer operations, synchronization primitives, and buffer administration for an inter-process communication or data streaming component.

classes.name: CyclicBuffer
classes.description: A class that implements a lockable, concurrent ring buffer with an administrator for managing read/write pointers, buffer size, and synchronization primitives for multi-thread or multi-process access.

methods.name: bool Validate()
methods.description: Ensures that the buffer and its administration structures are loaded and valid.

methods.name: void AdminLock()
methods.description: Acquires the lock on the buffer administrator, for synchronizing access to internal state.

methods.name: void AdminUnlock()
methods.description: Releases the lock on the buffer administrator.

methods.name: uint32_t SignalLock(const uint32_t waitTime)
methods.description: Waits on the condition variable or semaphore for notification, optionally with a timeout.

methods.name: void DataAvailable()
methods.description: Placeholder virtual method to notify that data is available; can be overridden.

methods.name: void Reevaluate()
methods.description: Re-invokes notifications to agents waiting for data or space.

methods.name: void Alert()
methods.description: Sets an alert flag and reevaluates wait conditions, typically to abort ongoing wait or processing.

methods.name: uint32_t Read(uint8_t buffer[],const uint32_t length,bool partialRead)
methods.description: Reads data from the buffer into a provided buffer, optionally allowing partial reads.

methods.name: uint32_t Write(const uint8_t buffer[],const uint32_t length)
methods.description: Writes data into the buffer from a provided buffer, handling wrap-around and possible reservations.

methods.name: void AssureFreeSpace(uint32_t required)
methods.description: Ensures there is enough space in the buffer to write a specified amount, expanding the tail pointer if needed.

methods.name: uint32_t Reserve(const uint32_t length)
methods.description: Reserves space in the buffer for a future write, returning the size reserved.

methods.name: uint32_t Lock(const bool dataPresent,const uint32_t waitTime)
methods.description: Locks the buffer for exclusive write or read access, optionally waiting for data to be present.

methods.name: uint32_t Unlock()
methods.description: Releases the lock on the buffer.

methods.name: uint32_t Peek(uint8_t buffer[],const uint32_t length) const
methods.description: Provides a non-destructive read of data from the buffer for inspection.

methods.name: uint32_t GetOverwriteSize(Cursor & cursor)
methods.description: Returns the size of data to be overwritten, virtual for customization.

methods.name: uint32_t GetReadSize(Cursor & cursor)
methods.description: Returns the size of data that can be read, virtual for customization.
